text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: W-W-Whoa!? What was that just now!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Power is welling up inside me... I feel 
like I've grown huuuge!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing! Since I got bigger, I've 
gotta eat tons of food too--!!
